mechanisms.what: Hard level switch lod0 <-> lod1 of every model car with no cross-fade. Repeated switches happen at the 38–42 m band, where steering-induced speed changes move the gap back and forth.
mechanisms.code: scripts/race3d/layers/vehicles.gd:539 (dist = z + length/2 - cam_z), :549-564 (switch, _set_level), :71 (XFADE_LODS = [lod1, lod2]), :252-253 (scaling by vehicle_lod0_m/lod1_m); scripts/race3d/vehicle_pose3d.gd:168-176 (lod_index), :19 (LOD_HYSTERESIS 0.05); scripts/gameplay/vehicle_model.gd:92 (understeer scrub up to 3 m/s2); ZS1 39849f0 and M2 6e48405 identical
mechanisms.effect: Measured (llvmpipe control scene, game camera, approximated light, white hatch/wagon at 40 m, 1280x800 and 1920x1080): 5.7–10.6 % of the car's pixels change by more than 24 levels, mean colour 1.5–3.3 levels. If the car crosses the medium-preset 36 m cascade boundary in the same moment: 8.5–11.4 %, 1.2–4.0. What jumps: the number plate (lod0 plate with characters and EU band, lod1 an empty field #c4c4c1 or none), the lamp rings and the windows (glass class in lod0, dark vpbr in lod1). The paint stays. It is a one-frame pop on every band crossing. Bands: 25 m (low), 40 m (medium/Deck), 60 m (high); trucks and buses at 1.5x those distances
mechanisms.why: It certainly occurs at exactly the reported distance (medium is the first-start preset for an 'ok' GPU). Steering causes understeer scrub (up to 3 m/s2), which moves the gap across the 4-m band; 1–2 s of scrub shifts it by about 1.5–6 m (inferred). The user calls it 'Grafikflackern' and puts 'verlor' in quotes. It shows most on white, because the dark rear details stand out. White SUV and van in ZS1 are sprite stand-ins with no levels. Weak point: the paint itself does not change

mechanisms.what: Godot refuses the instance uniforms of a vehicle level when the scene-wide global shader buffer is full. 4096 slots, 16 per instance, about 254 instances after the 18 ce_* globals. The refused level then reads wrong slots until its node is freed
mechanisms.code: assets/shaders/modern/vpbr.gdshader:44-59 (instance_index 0-9), glass.gdshader:11-12; vehicles.gd:37 (INSTANCE_BUDGET 128, vehicle layer only), :1152-1176 (_trim_instances: rebuild on next switch), :1242-1267 (_set_level builds on demand), :29 (POOL_PER_SET 6: a broken level travels with the pooled Car of the same set). Other users in ZS1: builders/props.gd:751-772/_mmi :824 (vpbr props; M2 moved them to VPBR_STATIC), roadside.gd:356, gantry.gd:158, station.gd:217, tunnel.gd:392 (still in M2)
mechanisms.effect: Measured (llvmpipe): paint (index 0) reads out of bounds and indices 1-9 read globals k-1. Result: the body is about half see-through as an ordered-dither checkerboard and the rest is flat and over-bright. 52–63 % of car pixels change by more than 24 levels, mean colour 21–72 levels. The damage persists until the node is freed (visible toggle, new values or freeing other slots do not heal it). It becomes visible each time the car enters the broken level, i.e. at the 40-m band. Godot processes dirty instances LIFO, so the earliest-queued instances of the overflowing frame are refused. Inferred for a real GPU: the out-of-bounds paint is driver-dependent (mostly 0); the dither looks the same on any GPU
mechanisms.why: The look is the only true 'paint loss' and the trigger fits too. But it was not reproduced on erfurt_kassel. Live Xvfb race with an engine-truth probe: 0 refusals, minimum free capacity 105 (from Erfurt, km 0-45) and 48 (from Kassel, km 100-136, 17:00, warmed-up traffic). The engine count equalled the scene count in all 43 probes. Headless over the whole stage (both directions, medium/high/Deck): at most 214 instances, i.e. a reserve of 40. An overflow needs about 40 more instances, e.g. three trucks at lod0. The user's godot*.log would settle it ('Too many instances using shader instance variables')

mechanisms.what: Directional shadow cascade boundary in the same distance range
mechanisms.code: scripts/race3d/environment_rig.gd:143-151 (bias 0.04, normal bias 1.2, blur 1.2), :181-194 (splits); config graphics.levels.shadows (medium: 2 splits, split_1 0.3 x 120 m = 36 m, no blend; high: 4 splits blended, 16/40/90 m; Deck 24 m)
mechanisms.effect: Measured: a cascade change with the car unchanged alters 0.4–4.7 % of the car's pixels (more than 24 levels), mean colour 0.1–3.3. It mostly affects the shadow under the rear. All levels cast the same hull (model_factory.gd:62-117; the body never casts), so self-shadowing is identical across levels
mechanisms.why: Right distance (36 m medium, 40 m high) and it is tied to speed. The camera yaw depends only on position, not steering. The change is small and is not paint

mechanisms.what: Lead hypothesis: the per-car cache of fade/sun/lamp_a/lamp_b is not reset, so a level shown later keeps stale or default values
mechanisms.code: vehicles.gd:1318-1323 (_set_level resets la, lb, mod, ovl, fade, sun to -1), :1090-1095 (_acquire resets), :852-867 (_set_uniforms), :632 (pushed in the same frame)
mechanisms.why: Both paths reset the cache, and every value is pushed again in the same frame. The paint is set on every build (model_factory.gd:122, apply_paint :214-221)

mechanisms.what: A newly built level draws one frame with old GPU buffer contents (slots of a just-freed instance, or a late upload)
mechanisms.code: Godot GLES3 global shader uniform buffer; scratch test skripte/flk_firstframe.gd
mechanisms.why: Measured under llvmpipe: four cases were all correct in the very first frame. These were a new instance on fresh slots, one on the slots of an instance freed in the same frame, one with no values set (defaults), and a value change. The ordering is CPU-side in Godot, so it is inferred to hold on any GPU

mechanisms.what: Paint codes in an atlas misread at coarse mips or under BC compression at 40 m (anisotropic filtering on a real GPU)
mechanisms.code: vpbr.gdshader / glass.gdshader: no sampler at all; vpbr.gdshader:128,245,267-272 (flat v_code from COLOR.a, thresholds 0.125/0.375/0.75)
mechanisms.why: Vehicles have no texture. The paint class is a per-vertex code: traffic uses only 0.000/1.000, trucks also 0.251/0.502. Distance to the nearest threshold is at least 0.124. Mixed-code triangles: 0 in every level of both builds (measured), so the provoking vertex (GL vs D3D/ANGLE) does not matter either

mechanisms.what: Race LOOK constants missing on a vehicle material created after the look was set
mechanisms.code: ZS1 vehicles.gd:51-62, 231-233; M2 ModernMaterials.VEHICLE_LOOK + apply_look; all builders use ModernMaterials.shared()
mechanisms.why: There is exactly one shared vpbr material and one shared glass material for every vehicle level. Both are created before any build. The look gap concerned static copies, which VPBR_STATIC handles in M2

mechanisms.what: surfaced_mesh() sets the surface material of the cached mesh; a non-vehicle user (M2 class_for -> VPBR_STATIC, no instance uniforms -> default grey paint) could flip it for all cars
mechanisms.why: No mesh file is shared between a vehicle and a non-vehicle model. Checked 68 meshes (ZS1) and 282 (M2) with shared_mesh.py

mechanisms.what: A pooled car is reused for another set or colour
mechanisms.why: The pool is kept per set and the paint is per set

mechanisms.what: Model or level loaded after the car appeared (ModelDB.request), shows a box or a half-built car
mechanisms.code: vehicles.gd:258-268 (prepare requests all wanted levels), :302-311 (prepare_pending; missing -> fail -> Arcade fallback)
mechanisms.why: The stage starts only once all wanted levels are loaded

mechanisms.what: lod1/lod2 cross-fade dither (xfade) left on a level
mechanisms.why: The cross-fade is only used at 90/120/160 m. Every interruption ends in _xfade_end, which resets xfade to 0

mechanisms.what: Path-distance fade dither reaching a car at 40 m
mechanisms.why: The fade starts at 0.45 x visibility, and visibility is 900 m x weather x night factor. In a tunnel, alpha at 40 m is 0.97. It is continuous, not a flicker

mechanisms.what: Sprite stand-in (white SUV/van in ZS1) picks an out-of-range cell or layer row, or mip bleeding between cells
mechanisms.effect: none beyond Arcade's own cell changes
mechanisms.why: pick_cell always returns a valid cell. Cell changes on lateral camera movement behave as in Arcade. Kind 0 ignores instance uniforms, so it is immune to M1

mechanisms.what: Clear-coat sun lobe or analytic sky reflection jumps with the viewing angle
mechanisms.why: It is the same for every level and adds light rather than removing paint. sky_update_s does not affect vpbr (analytic sky, SPECULAR 0)

mechanisms.what: Player headlights swing with the steering
mechanisms.why: The beam follows the road heading, and only at night

sizes: Switch distances (both builds, same config). Cars and police, lod0<->lod1 hard switch: 25 m low (23.75–26.25), 40 m medium/Deck (38–42), 60 m high (57–63). lod1<->lod2 (0.5 s cross-fade): 90/120/160 m. Trucks and buses (manifest 60/180): 37.5/60/90 m and 135/180/240 m. Player models have only lod0 (no switch). Hysteresis ±5 %.

ZS1+M2 traffic/hatch: lod0 14 388 tris (body vpbr+glass, 4 wheels vpbr, shadow hull vpbr = 6 instances), lod1 5 661 (merged vpbr body + hull = 2), lod2 1 180 (M2 1 197, = 2). Codes 0.000/1.000 only, 0 mixed triangles. Visible paint share 0.63/0.58/0.57, glass 0.07 only in lod0. Paint uniform hatch_white #e8e8e5 metal 0.1 (ZS1) or #d8d8d5 (M2).

ZS1+M2 traffic/wagon: 14 216 / 5 941 / 1 141 (M2 1 176) tris. Codes 0/1 only. Paint share 0.63/0.58/0.53, glass 0.07 in lod0. wagon_white #e6e6e3 (ZS1) or #d8d8d5 (M2). traffic/sedan: 14 307 / 5 809 / 1 149, same classes.

traffic/truck: ZS1 4 772 / 4 672 / 1 490 tris (tractor or whole), M2 5 698 / 5 174 / 1 346. Codes 0 / 0.251 / 0.502 / (0.902, lod0 only) / 1. lod0 has 13 instances. truck_white #d8d8d6 is a model in both builds.

M2 only: traffic/suv, van, sports at about 14.0–14.5k / 5.7–5.9k / 1.2k tris, codes 0/1, glass 0.06–0.09 only in lod0. bus 13 174 / 6 398 / 1 500 (codes 0/0.251/0.502/1). police/de 16 985 / 5 656 / 1 196 (0/0.220 lod0 only/0.251/1). police/fr and police/it are similar, and police lod2 partly drops paint3.
Player models (lod0 only): ZS1 kompakt and limousine with codes 0/0.078/0.157/0.176/0.361/1. M2 has five players, and the 0.361 code becomes 0.478.

Look constants (identical for every level, one shared material each). ZS1 vehicles.gd LOOK sets vpbr env_energy 1.6, paint_base 1.0, paint_knee 0.7, paint_knee_slope 0.45, paint_desat 0.08, flake_strength 0.6, lamp_off 0.28, tail_level 0.5, env_night 0.35, fill_night 0.3, and glass env_energy 2.2. M2 VEHICLE_LOOK has the same values except flake_strength 0.0. Vehicle shaders have no textures, so there are no atlas mips or BC.

Instance-uniform cost: every vpbr/glass/vehicle_sprite node takes 16 of the 4096 slots. That leaves 254 instances per scene after the 18 globals (measured: reserve + count = 254 in all 43 probes). Measured on erfurt_kassel: live maximum 206 (km 136 from Kassel, 17:00), headless maximum 214, i.e. a minimum reserve of 40.

fix_options.option: D – Make lod1 match lod0 at the switch distance (root cause of M2, in the models). Give lod1 lod0's number plate (light plate, band, mean character colour as a flat area), lamp rings as faces, and a window colour equal to the mean look of lod0's glass at 40 m. Accept per model, level and preset (25/40/60 m, trucks 37.5/60/90 m) at 1280x800 and 1920x1080, day/dusk/night: changed car pixels (>24 levels) <= 2 %, mean colour <= 1 level
solves: M2-LOD-POP for every vehicle model and level
fix_options.risks: Art work per model family, plus re-export, validator and contact sheets. lod1 gets slightly heavier (about +100 tris). lod1<->lod2 must be re-checked
fix_options.fairness: None. The silhouette and size are unchanged and the lights are separate (flares), so F1/F6 hold

fix_options.option: A – Instance uniforms only where their count is bounded (root cause of M1). Move roadside, gantry, station and tunnel portal (roadside.gd:356, gantry.gd:158, station.gd:217, tunnel.gd:392) to VPBR_STATIC, as M2 did for props. Give the vehicle shadow hull a static material (it only casts): lod0 drops from 6 to 5 instances, lod1/lod2 from 2 to 1. Use a variant without instance uniform for the kind-0 sprite batches
fix_options.risks: Low; the image stays the same (as instanzen_wald showed for props). One more shader variant to prewarm

fix_options.option: B – Scene-wide instance budget. The renderer counts every node with instance uniforms (builders report theirs); the limit is 254 minus a reserve. The vehicle layer keeps its share including shown levels. When short, the farthest lod0 cars show lod1 (with D this is invisible)
solves: M1-INSTANCE-REFUSAL under dense traffic or high preset
fix_options.risks: A rare extra level downgrade. Testable by extending check_instance_budget to erfurt_kassel on high with a traffic jam
fix_options.fairness: None. The car is never hidden or smaller, and its lights are unaffected

fix_options.option: C – Watchdog. A Logger in the Modern renderer catches 'Too many instances ...', counts instance_refusals in perf_stats and the log, and after making room rebuilds the vehicle levels built in that frame (a refusal never heals). Render checks fail on any refusal; the engine probe of flk_refusal_run.gd can serve as a per-stage reserve check
fix_options.risks: Depends on the engine message text (a test pins it)

fix_options.option: A' – Vehicles without instance uniforms at all: each pooled Car object gets its own vpbr and glass material, and the per-car values become material uniforms
fix_options.risks: About 2 x visible cars material uploads per frame; Steam Deck cost must be measured; larger change in R3 code

fix_options.option: E – Also cross-fade lod0<->lod1 (add lod0 to XFADE_LODS; glass needs xfade at index 9)
solves: Hides M2-LOD-POP (0.5 s dither instead of a one-frame pop)
fix_options.risks: A cover-up only (the contract puts root cause before cover-up). Extra draw calls per car while fading

fix_options.option: F – Wider hysteresis (LOD_HYSTERESIS 0.05 -> 0.15, medium band 34–46 m)
solves: Fewer repeated pops when following a car (helps M2)

fix_options.option: G – Cascades: shadow_blend at medium, or move split_1 away from the LOD band
fix_options.risks: One more shader variant and some GPU cost

fix_options.option: H – Ask the user for %APPDATA%\crossing-europe-zwischenstand\logs\godot*.log and settings.json
solves: Decides between M1 and M2 for his report

notes: Summary: the user most likely saw the hard lod0<->lod1 switch (M2), which pops at 38–42 m on medium; steering-induced understeer moves the gap across the band. It changes plate, lamp rings and windows (measured 5.7–11.4 % of car pixels), not the paint. The only real 'paint loss' path is a refused instance-uniform level (M1); it was not reproduced on this stage (0 refusals, minimum reserve 48 live, 40 headless). All numbers are from llvmpipe; anything about the user's GPU is inferred.

Regardless of the log, D (invisible switch) and A+B+C (overflow class) are needed in the M2 head. The 'level switch invisible at every preset' rule is violated by every model car today, and a reserve of 40 out of 254 is thin (M2INT already saw refusals on forest stages).

New measurements in this run: (1) a live race engine-truth probe (300 probe quads in a paused frame), where engine usage equalled the scene count in all 43 probes, so there are no hidden consumers; (2) first-frame test, where a newly allocated or changed instance is correct in its first frame; (3) Godot allocates dirty instances LIFO, so the first-queued instances of an overflowing frame are refused; (4) no mesh is shared between vehicle and non-vehicle models.

Race and direction: erfurt_kassel appears only in the race Dresden–Dortmund (Erfurt -> Kassel). Kassel -> Erfurt, as the user wrote it, exists only as a single stage. The densest point is km 136 from Kassel (live 206, headless 214 instances).

Contract issue D20 / §4.6.4: instance uniforms are prescribed for all vpbr, but the engine limit (254 instances per scene at a 64 KB uniform block) is not stated. Proposal: instance uniforms for vehicles only, plus a scene-wide budget with a check.

Contract issue D9 / §4.6.9: 'hard switches hidden by distance and fog' does not hold at 40 m (measured 5.7–11.4 %). There is no acceptance limit for vehicle level switches; propose <= 2 % of car pixels above 24 levels and mean colour <= 1 level at every preset.
Task-text issue: 'paint codes in the atlas' does not apply. vpbr and glass have no textures; paint is a per-vertex code (contract §4.6.3/§4.6.4).

Next: get the user's godot*.log and settings.json. Use the flk_refusal_run.gd engine probe as a render check on M2 forest stages and with traffic jams. Re-measure D with real EnvironmentRig lighting (FLACKER-NACHSTELLEN reproduces in the real race).
